item.title: SEN. TIM SCOTT And SEN. CYNTHIA LUMMIS: Why Digital Asset Reform Can’t Wait
item.description: Historically, the United States has been the world’s leader in financial innovation, but the Biden administration’s hostility to digital assets weakened the United States’ leadership. The Biden administration targeted the digital asset industry and failed to protect investors or provide clear rules of the road.

item.title: Radical Groups Like Renee Good’s Are Tailing ICE All Over America
item.description: The leftist group involved in a deadly Jan. 7 incident with Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) in Minnesota is one of countless ICE-tracking networks using confrontational tactics nationwide.

item.title: 81 Republicans Vote With Democrats To Fund Deep State Slush Fund That Targeted Conservatives
item.description: Dozens of Republicans joined all voting Democrats on Wednesday evening to reject a GOP-led effort to eliminate federal funding for a nonprofit organization accused of bias against conservatives.

item.title: Senate, Vance Barely Kill Effort To Check Trump On Venezuela After Hawley, Young Flip Their Votes
item.description: The Senate voted 51 to 50 to table a resolution Wednesday that would have blocked President Donald Trump from using future military force on Venezuela.

item.title: Chris Murphy Wants To Jack Up Taxes On Certain Accessories And Guns Sky High
item.description: Democratic Sen. Chris Murphy of Connecticut introduced an amendment to an appropriations bill Monday seeking to impose a massive tax increase on suppressors and certain firearms.

item.title: Trump DOJ Says In Court Maduro Removed Due To Illegal Mining
item.description: The Trump administration’s Department of Justice (DOJ) told a federal court in a filing that U.S. force against Venezuelan dictator Nicolás Maduro was justified in part by humanitarian harms tied to illegal mining.

item.title: DHS Says ICE Agent Shoots Man After Being Ambushed In Minneapolis
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security said Wednesday that an agent from the United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) shot an illegal immigrant from Venezuela after being ambushed.
